caseNameFull: Growe, Secretary of State of Minnesota v. Emison

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. Minn. Motion to expedite consideration of jurisdictional statement granted. Ap-*929pellees’ response to the jurisdictional statement is to be filed with the Clerk of this Court and served upon counsel for appellants on or before 1 p.m., Monday, March 23, 1992.
